title: 法國東歐高速鐵路~LGV Est europeenne
focus: 跨區高速線分期銜接與控制互通~Phased high speed connections and control interoperability
summary: 以法國東歐高速鐵路兩階段建設為背景，建立新舊路段銜接、模式轉換和供電邊界的教學案例。學徒必須以訊號有效期、定位誤差及速度曲線共同驗證列車如何通過介面，並區分通訊可用與安全授權有效。~Use the two construction phases of LGV Est europeenne to frame a teaching case involving old-new route connections, mode transitions and supply boundaries. Verify passage through interfaces using authority validity, position error and speed curves together. Distinguish available communication from a valid movement authority, and require explicit evidence for each transition condition in the operational sequence.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 stale_distance=7.725 m；單元 2 得 sigma=1.799212 m；單元 3 得 transition=2768.008 m。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 latency 的擾動測試，結果改為 8.4975 m；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以法國東歐高速鐵路兩階段建設為背景，建立新舊路段銜接、模式轉換和供電邊界的教學案例。學徒必須以訊號有效期、定位誤差及速度曲線共同驗證列車如何通過介面，並區分通訊可用與安全授權有效。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives stale_distance=7.725 m; unit 2 gives sigma=1.799212 m; unit 3 gives transition=2768.008 m. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing latency in the first unit changes its result to 8.4975 m. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the two construction phases of LGV Est europeenne to frame a teaching case involving old-new route connections, mode transitions and supply boundaries. Verify passage through interfaces using authority validity, position error and speed curves together. Distinguish available communication from a valid movement authority, and require explicit evidence for each transition condition in the operational sequence. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：2007 年：法國東歐高速鐵路第一期開始營運；2016 年：法國東歐高速鐵路第二期開始營運。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以法國東歐高速鐵路兩階段建設為背景，建立新舊路段銜接、模式轉換和供電邊界的教學案例。學徒必須以訊號有效期、定位誤差及速度曲線共同驗證列車如何通過介面，並區分通訊可用與安全授權有效。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 2007: The first phase of LGV Est europeenne entered service; 2016: The second phase of LGV Est europeenne entered service. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the two construction phases of LGV Est europeenne to frame a teaching case involving old-new route connections, mode transitions and supply boundaries. Verify passage through interfaces using authority validity, position error and speed curves together. Distinguish available communication from a valid movement authority, and require explicit evidence for each transition condition in the operational sequence. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量~Communication delay and stale position
units.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量~Communication delay and stale position
units.mechanism: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。封包延遲、遺失與時鐘偏差應分開，平均延遲不能代表最壞情況，也不能直接替代列車保護的安全論證。 傳輸時間不是訊息年齡的全部，排隊、重送及接收端處理也可能占主要比例。安全邏輯應明確定義逾時後的狀態；成功收到舊封包不能當成最新授權。 在模式轉換前後分別檢查封包年齡與授權到期時刻。~A moving train advances while a message is in transit. Speed times delay gives the simplest stale-position bound. Packet delay, loss and clock bias must be separated; mean latency neither represents a worst case nor replaces a safety argument for train protection. Transmission time is not the entire message age; queueing, retransmission and receiver processing may dominate. Safety logic needs an explicit state after timeout. Successful receipt of an old packet is not equivalent to a fresh movement authority. Check packet age and authority expiry separately before and after a mode transition.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.309 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.725 m。敏感度：latency 單獨增加百分之十至 0.3399 s，其餘固定，結果為 8.4975 m。模型邊界：固定速度且單次訊息延遲；未含加速度、連續遺失及協定重試。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.309 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.725 m. Sensitivity: latency, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.3399 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.4975 m. Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded.
units.verify: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 以發送與接收端同步時鐘核對端到端延遲，記錄重送次數、封包遺失及最長連續中斷。~Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Use synchronised sender and receiver clocks to check end-to-end delay, recording retries, packet loss and the longest continuous interruption.
units.failure: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 先檢查序號與時間戳，避免把重播封包誤認為狀態恢復。~Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Check sequence numbers and timestamps before interpreting a replayed packet as state recovery.
units.misconception: 平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達~A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.
units.practice: 把速度與延遲各提高一成，比較位置陳舊量；設計含連續遺失的重播案例，列出接收端需要保留的時間與序號資訊。 再以本單元 latency 的對照值重算 stale_distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase speed and delay separately, compare stale distance, and design a replay with consecutive losses listing the timestamps and sequence information required at the receiver. Also recalculate stale_distance for the alternative latency value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 里程融合與不確定度~Position fusion and uncertainty
units.title: 里程融合與不確定度~Position fusion and uncertainty
units.mechanism: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。輪徑誤差和共同地圖偏差可能讓多個通道一起偏移，不能靠增加感測器數量消除。 兩個獨立無偏估計的資訊量可以相加，較小變異數應獲較大權重。共同偏差不會被這種融合消除，相關性也會破壞公式；較小標準差只能表示宣告模型下的精密度。 將定位的不確定區間帶入路段邊界，檢查前端位置定義。~Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected. Wheel-diameter error and shared map bias can shift multiple channels together, so merely adding sensors does not remove systematic error. Information from two independent unbiased estimates can be combined, assigning greater weight to smaller variance. Shared bias is not removed by this fusion, and correlation invalidates the expression. Smaller standard deviation represents precision only under the declared statistical model. Carry position uncertainty into the section boundary and verify the train-front reference.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.12 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.799212 m。敏感度：s1 單獨增加百分之十至 4.532 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.829748 m。模型邊界：零均值獨立高斯誤差；不含共同偏差與完整性風險。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: s1=4.12 m; s2=2 m; calculation: sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.799212 m. Sensitivity: s1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 4.532 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.829748 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean Gaussian errors; common bias and integrity risk are excluded.
units.verify: 以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。 以外部參考位置核對兩感測器殘差，檢查平均偏差及相關係數，再比較融合後覆蓋範圍。~Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation. Check both sensor residuals against an external position reference, examine mean bias and correlation, and compare coverage after fusion.
units.failure: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 若兩感測器共用錯誤基準，融合後仍會保持共同偏差。~A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. If both sensors share a wrong reference, the fused result retains the common bias.
units.misconception: 兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差~Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.
units.practice: 建立獨立誤差與共同偏差兩組資料，對比融合結果，指出哪一種誤差需要外部控制點才能發現。 再以本單元 s1 的對照值重算 sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Construct independent-error and common-bias datasets, compare their fused results, and identify the error requiring an external control point for detection. Also recalculate sigma for the alternative s1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 速度限制轉換與預告距離~Speed-limit transition and warning distance
units.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離~Speed-limit transition and warning distance
units.mechanism: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。此處用明示減速度得到教學距離，真正保護曲線還需加入定位誤差、坡度、制動建立及車輛差異。 目標速度不一定是零，進入較低速區也需要保護距離。計算使用同一距離基準與速度單位，並把定位誤差和延遲裕度分開，才能避免重複或漏加安全邊界。 連結目標速度限制和定位誤差，檢查保護距離是否仍成立。~Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy. The expression contains the difference of squared initial and target speeds. A teaching deceleration gives one distance; a real protection curve additionally needs position uncertainty, gradient, brake build-up and vehicle variation. The target speed need not be zero: entry into a lower-speed section also requires protection distance. Use one distance reference and consistent speed units. Keep localisation uncertainty and delay margins separate to prevent duplicated or omitted boundaries. Connect target-speed restrictions and position error when checking protective distance.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：initial=72.1 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2；計算：transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=2768.008 m。敏感度：initial 單獨增加百分之十至 79.31 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 3607.751 m。模型邊界：初速大於目標速度且定減速度；沒有通訊延遲與安全裕度。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: initial=72.1 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2; calculation: transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=2768.008 m. Sensitivity: initial, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 79.31 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 3607.751 m. Model boundary: Initial speed above target and constant deceleration; communication delay and safety margins are excluded.
units.verify: 重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。 以已知初速與目標速度重播控制資料，核對速度單位、里程方向及列車前端參考位置。~Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope. Replay control data at known initial and target speeds, checking speed units, chainage direction and the reference position of the train front.
units.failure: 限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 若目標速度高於初速，此減速模型的工況設定便不成立。~A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. If target speed exceeds initial speed, the stated deceleration case no longer applies.
units.misconception: 降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差~Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored.
units.practice: 對同一初速設定兩個目標速度，重算轉換距離，畫出能量差並說明為何不能按速度差線性縮放距離。 再以本單元 initial 的對照值重算 transition，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Use two target speeds at one initial speed, recalculate transition distance, plot the energy differences, and explain why distance cannot scale linearly with the speed difference. Also recalculate transition for the alternative initial value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.mechanism: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 為新舊線交會設計進路互斥邏輯與故障狀態。~Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. Design route exclusion logic and fault states for the junction between new and old lines.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=7 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=128 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 8 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 256 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=7 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=128 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 8 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 256 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested.
units.verify: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。~Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority.
units.failure: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。~Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well.
units.misconception: 聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求~Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
units.practice: 為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 無電區惰行與速度損失~Coasting through an unpowered section
units.title: 無電區惰行與速度損失~Coasting through an unpowered section
units.mechanism: 列車通過無電區時需依靠動能克服阻力，簡化恆阻力模型把阻力做功從初始動能扣除。區段長度、初速與坡度決定剩餘速度，供電切換邏輯和防誤合閘仍需獨立驗證。 無牽引不等於無運動，列車以動能克服所宣告的阻力。若距離超過此阻力下的可滑行距離，平方根將無實數解，表示通過情境不成立而非計算器錯誤。 在供電邊界比較不同入口速度下的滑行通過時間。~A train coasting through an unpowered section uses kinetic energy to overcome resistance. A constant-resistance model subtracts work from initial kinetic energy. Length, entry speed and gradient determine remaining speed, while switching logic and prevention of inappropriate re-energisation require separate verification. No traction does not mean no motion: kinetic energy overcomes the declared resistance. If the section exceeds the available coasting distance, the square root has no real solution, indicating an infeasible passage case rather than a calculator malfunction. Compare coasting passage time across a supply boundary for different entry speeds.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=50 m/s; force=15450 N; length=500 m; mass=250000 kg；計算：exit_speed=(v*v-2*force*length/mass)**0.5=49.37813 m/s。敏感度：force 單獨增加百分之十至 16995 N，其餘固定，結果為 49.31551 m/s。模型邊界：水平路線且恆阻力，根號內必須非負；不含低速停車及切換暫態。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=50 m/s; force=15450 N; length=500 m; mass=250000 kg; calculation: exit_speed=(v*v-2*force*length/mass)**0.5=49.37813 m/s. Sensitivity: force, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 16995 N, with all other inputs fixed, gives 49.31551 m/s. Model boundary: Level track and constant resistance with a nonnegative radicand; stopping within the section and switching transients are excluded.
units.verify: 同步記錄受電電壓、主斷路器狀態和列車速度，確認無電區邊界與里程一致，再核對惰行能量差。 以入口和出口獨立速度對照滑行距離，核對斷電區時間戳及坡度是否被模型排除。~Synchronise line voltage, main-breaker status and speed, align electrical boundaries with distance coordinates, and check the coasting energy difference. Compare independently measured entry and exit speeds with coasting distance, checking power-off timestamps and whether gradient is excluded.
units.failure: 邊界定位誤差可能使主斷路器切換時機錯誤；把坡度阻力遺漏會低估上坡無電區的速度下降。 若計算顯示無法通過，不能把負根號截成零後繼續排程。~Boundary-position error can mistime breaker switching; omitting gradient resistance understates speed loss in an uphill unpowered section. If passage is infeasible, do not clamp a negative radicand to zero and continue scheduling.
units.misconception: 無電區長度改變不會影響列車離開時的速度~Changing the length of an unpowered section cannot change exit speed.
units.practice: 在相同初速下增加區段長度，檢查能量是否足夠通過，再列出電氣切換與機械惰行模型各自需要的驗證資料。 再以本單元 force 的對照值重算 exit_speed，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase section length at fixed entry speed, test whether energy remains sufficient, and list separate evidence for electrical switching and mechanical coasting models. Also recalculate exit_speed for the alternative force value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 接觸線張力波速~Contact-wire tension wave speed
units.title: 接觸線張力波速~Contact-wire tension wave speed
units.mechanism: 受電弓擾動會沿接觸線傳播，張力提高使橫波速度上升而線密度增加使波速下降。波速與列車速度的比值提供動態風險線索，但多跨懸掛、吊弦和接觸非線性不能由單根弦模型取代。 線密度決定單位長度的慣性，張力提供恢復作用，因此波速平方與張力成正比。提高張力也改變支承受力；波速裕度只能作篩檢，不能推定接觸力必然均勻。 檢查高速段架線波速與支承變化對受電的限制。~Pantograph disturbances propagate along the contact wire. Greater tension raises transverse wave speed, whereas greater mass per length lowers it. The ratio to train speed offers a dynamic clue, but multispan suspension, droppers and contact nonlinearity cannot be replaced by a single-string model. Linear density represents inertia per unit length and tension supplies restoring force, so squared wave speed scales with tension. Higher tension also changes support loading. A wave-speed margin is a screening measure, not proof of uniform contact force. Inspect contact-wire wave speed and support changes as limits on high-speed collection.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：tension=20600 N; density=1.1 kg/m；計算：wave_speed=(tension/density)**0.5=136.8476 m/s。敏感度：tension 單獨增加百分之十至 22660 N，其餘固定，結果為 143.527 m/s。模型邊界：無彎曲剛度的均勻張弦；不是受流合格判定或允許車速。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: tension=20600 N; density=1.1 kg/m; calculation: wave_speed=(tension/density)**0.5=136.8476 m/s. Sensitivity: tension, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 22660 N, with all other inputs fixed, gives 143.527 m/s. Model boundary: Uniform tensioned string without bending stiffness; not a current-collection acceptance rule or permitted train speed.
units.verify: 核對補償裝置行程、線溫與張力紀錄，再量測受電弓接觸力統計及離線事件，辨別平均值正常但峰值異常。 核對接觸線張力、單位長度質量及量測位置，並用接觸力和離線事件檢查動態品質。~Check compensation travel, wire temperature and tension, then examine contact-force statistics and loss-of-contact events to distinguish acceptable means from abnormal peaks. Verify contact-wire tension, mass per unit length and measurement location, then examine contact force and loss-of-contact events for dynamic quality.
units.failure: 補償裝置卡滯會讓溫度變化改變張力，吊弦鬆弛又會改變局部動態剛度；只讀取靜態高度難以辨識。 波速符合估算仍可能離線，需查看接觸力的時間歷程。~A sticking tensioning device lets temperature change tension, while slack droppers change local dynamic stiffness; static wire height alone cannot identify either mechanism. Agreement in wave-speed estimates does not rule out contact loss; inspect contact-force histories.
units.misconception: 只要靜態接觸線高度正確就能保證高速受流品質~Correct static contact-wire height alone guarantees good current collection at high speed.
units.practice: 將張力降低一成和線密度增加一成分別計算波速，列出尚需哪些接觸力量測才能討論動態受流品質。 再以本單元 tension 的對照值重算 wave_speed，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Reduce tension and increase wire mass density separately by ten percent, calculate wave speed, and identify the contact-force measurements still needed to assess dynamic collection. Also recalculate wave_speed for the alternative tension value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 側風力與翻覆力矩~Crosswind force and overturning moment
units.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩~Crosswind force and overturning moment
units.mechanism: 側風作用可由動壓乘有效側向面積估算，再乘作用高度形成翻覆力矩。車輛質量、重心、風向及橋面遮蔽同時影響輪重分配，單一靜態力矩只能提供比較而非營運風速門檻。 橫向力依側風分量平方變化，列車姿態和地形會改變受風面積及係數。此力尺度不直接給出傾覆門檻；還需重心、輪重減載、懸吊和陣風時間歷程。 將開闊地段側風方向分解為列車橫向作用。~Crosswind force can be estimated from dynamic pressure and effective lateral area, then multiplied by application height for an overturning moment. Mass, centre of gravity, wind direction and shielding affect wheel loading together; one static moment only supports comparison, not an operational wind threshold. Lateral force varies with squared crosswind component, while vehicle attitude and terrain change exposed area and coefficients. The force scale does not directly yield an overturning threshold; centre of gravity, wheel unloading, suspension and gust history remain necessary. Resolve open-country wind direction into the component acting across the train.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25.75 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m；計算：moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=71.61075 kN*m。敏感度：wind 單獨增加百分之十至 28.325 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 86.64901 kN*m。模型邊界：定常橫風與已假設氣動係數；不含陣風、列車運動與動態輪重減載。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25.75 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m; calculation: moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=71.61075 kN*m. Sensitivity: wind, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 28.325 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 86.64901 kN*m. Model boundary: Steady crosswind and assumed aerodynamic coefficient; gusts, train motion and dynamic unloading are excluded.
units.verify: 同步記錄沿線風速、風向、列車速度及車體側滾，檢查風速站是否受地形遮蔽，再用多點資料評估代表性。 核對風速計高度與方向，保存陣風時序，將列車姿態與側向加速度放在同一時間軸。~Synchronise wind speed, direction, train speed and carbody roll, inspect terrain shielding at the anemometer, and assess representativeness with multiple locations. Verify anemometer height and orientation, retain gust histories, and align vehicle attitude with lateral acceleration on one timeline.
units.failure: 受遮蔽的風速計可能低估橋上曝露，空載與滿載車又具有不同抗翻覆力矩；不能只用最近測站單一讀值。 日平均風速會掩蓋陣風，需檢查量測平均時間與峰值。~A sheltered anemometer can understate exposure on a viaduct, and empty versus loaded vehicles have different restoring moments; the nearest sensor alone is insufficient. Daily mean wind hides gusts; inspect averaging duration and the recorded peaks.
units.misconception: 側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度~Crosswind overturning moment is linear in wind speed and independent of vehicle height.
units.practice: 把風速與作用高度各增加一成，對比力矩敏感度，提出能區分地形加速與儀器誤差的多點量測配置。 再以本單元 wind 的對照值重算 moment，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase wind speed and load height separately by ten percent, compare moment sensitivity, and propose measurements distinguishing terrain acceleration from instrument error. Also recalculate moment for the alternative wind value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 空氣阻力與牽引功率~Aerodynamic drag and traction power
units.title: 空氣阻力與牽引功率~Aerodynamic drag and traction power
units.mechanism: 高速列車的空氣阻力與速度平方成正比，而克服此阻力所需功率再乘一次速度，形成三次方敏感度。有效阻力面積包含外形與附屬物影響；會車、隧道及側風會使定常自由場模型失效。 阻力是速度平方關係，而牽引功率還要乘一次速度。把逆風納入時應使用相對空氣速度；滾動阻力與坡度功率是另外的能量途徑，不能被此氣動項取代。 比較高速與降速工況的氣動功率，說明降速的能源效果。~Aerodynamic drag scales with speed squared, and the power needed to overcome it adds another speed factor. Effective drag area includes shape and attachments. Passing trains, tunnels and crosswinds can invalidate the steady open-air approximation even when the nominal speed remains unchanged. Drag varies with squared speed, while traction power introduces another speed factor. Headwind requires relative air speed. Rolling resistance and gradient power are separate energy paths and cannot be replaced by this aerodynamic term. Compare aerodynamic power in fast and restricted operation to explain the energy effect of reduced speed.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; CdA=10 m^2; v=72.1 m/s；計算：power=0.5*rho*CdA*v**3/1000=2248.832 kW。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 79.31 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 2993.196 kW。模型邊界：定常靜風且阻力面積固定；僅空氣阻力功率，不含輪軌阻力與效率。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; CdA=10 m^2; v=72.1 m/s; calculation: power=0.5*rho*CdA*v**3/1000=2248.832 kW. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 79.31 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 2993.196 kW. Model boundary: Steady still air and constant drag area; aerodynamic power only, excluding rolling resistance and conversion losses.
units.verify: 在相同編組與天候下做不同速度的惰行分析，記錄風速方向與車頭迎角，避免把坡度造成的加速度誤判成空阻。 同步紀錄風向風速與地速，將穩速段牽引功率扣除可辨識的坡度和輔助負載。~Compare coast-down observations across speeds with the same consist, log wind speed and direction, and separate gradient acceleration from aerodynamic resistance. Record wind vector and ground speed together, then remove identifiable gradient and auxiliary loads from steady-running traction power.
units.failure: 車底設備改變或側風會改變有效阻力面積；若只以單一速度校準，仍可能在另一速度得到錯誤牽引需求。 需核對風向，避免把順風和逆風的相對速度互換。~Underbody changes and crosswinds alter effective drag area; fitting one speed can still produce a wrong traction requirement at another speed. Check wind direction to avoid reversing the relative-speed treatment of headwind and tailwind.
units.misconception: 速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成~A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent.
units.practice: 對速度增加一成與阻力面積減少一成各算一次，對比功率節省，並把輪軌阻力另列以避免誇大整列節能比例。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Calculate a ten percent speed increase and a ten percent drag-area reduction separately, compare power changes, and keep rolling resistance separate from whole-train energy savings. Also recalculate power for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 空間波長與量測取樣~Spatial wavelength and sampling
units.title: 空間波長與量測取樣~Spatial wavelength and sampling
units.mechanism: 移動量測車把軌道空間波長轉成時間頻率，速度除波長得到激振頻率。要避免混疊，取樣率需高於訊號頻寬兩倍並搭配抗混疊濾波；提高取樣率本身不能修正輪滑造成的里程誤差。 取樣頻率超過訊號最高頻率兩倍是重建的必要起點，仍需要抗混疊濾波及足夠振幅精度。尖峰與非平穩事件的要求不同，應從量測目的回推頻寬與記錄長度。 以模式切換事件時間寬度檢查記錄器的取樣需求。~A moving inspection vehicle converts track wavelength into temporal frequency through speed divided by wavelength. Avoiding aliasing requires a sampling rate above twice the signal bandwidth and an antialias filter. A higher sample rate alone cannot correct distance errors caused by wheel slip. Sampling above twice the highest signal frequency is a starting condition for reconstruction, but anti-alias filtering and amplitude accuracy remain necessary. Peaks and nonstationary events have different needs; derive bandwidth and recording duration from the measurement objective. Use mode-transition event duration to check recorder sampling requirements.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：speed=51.5 m/s; wavelength=2 m；計算：nyquist_lower_bound=2*speed/wavelength=51.5 samples/s。敏感度：speed 單獨增加百分之十至 56.65 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 56.65 samples/s。模型邊界：單一最短波長的理想Nyquist下界；實務需留濾波與取樣裕度。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: speed=51.5 m/s; wavelength=2 m; calculation: nyquist_lower_bound=2*speed/wavelength=51.5 samples/s. Sensitivity: speed, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 56.65 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 56.65 samples/s. Model boundary: Ideal Nyquist lower bound for one shortest wavelength; practical filters and sampling need additional margin.
units.verify: 用已知波長的校驗訊號檢查量測鏈，對照獨立里程基準，並在不同車速下比較空間頻譜是否一致。 用已知頻率訊號測試整條量測鏈，檢查抗混疊濾波器、時鐘誤差與遺漏樣本。~Check the chain with a known-wavelength reference, compare an independent distance datum, and inspect whether spatial spectra agree at different vehicle speeds. Test the complete measurement chain with a known-frequency signal, checking anti-alias filtering, clock error and missing samples.
units.failure: 不足取樣會把短波缺陷偽裝成長波，里程跳動又會改變重採樣位置；兩者需分別診斷。 降低取樣率後出現新低頻峰值，應先查混疊而非機械故障。~Undersampling disguises short-wave defects as long waves, while distance jumps alter resampling positions; the two mechanisms require separate diagnosis. A new low-frequency peak after downsampling requires checking aliasing before diagnosing a mechanical fault.
units.misconception: 量測車速度提高時仍可永遠沿用原本取樣率~The original sampling rate remains sufficient at every increased inspection speed.
units.practice: 把速度提高一成並把最短波長減半，計算取樣率需求，繪出混疊示意後提出抗混疊濾波的頻寬要求。 再以本單元 speed 的對照值重算 nyquist_lower_bound，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase speed by ten percent and halve the shortest wavelength, calculate sampling needs, illustrate aliasing, and specify the required antialias-filter bandwidth. Also recalculate nyquist_lower_bound for the alternative speed value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 並聯備援與共同原因~Parallel redundancy and common cause
units.title: 並聯備援與共同原因~Parallel redundancy and common cause
units.mechanism: 兩個獨立元件只要有一個成功即可服務時，系統失效機率等於兩者失效機率相乘。但共用電源、軟體或環境會破壞獨立假設，備援數量增加不能自動證明整體風險按平方下降。 獨立失效機率相乘只在共同原因可忽略時成立。共用機房、電源、時鐘或軟體缺陷會使冗餘失去預期效果；應把獨立事件與共同事件分成不同邏輯項。 辨認通訊與電源共因，避免把兩個設備當作完全獨立。~When either of two independent components can serve the demand, system failure probability is the product of their failure probabilities. Shared power, software or environment breaks independence. More redundant components therefore do not automatically prove a squared reduction in overall risk. Multiplying failure probabilities requires negligible common causes. Shared rooms, power, clocks or software defects can defeat expected redundancy. Represent independent events and common events as separate logical terms rather than silently combining them. Identify shared communication and power causes instead of assuming two devices are independent.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：q1=0.0206 1; q2=0.03 1；計算：joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000618 1。敏感度：q1 單獨增加百分之十至 0.02266 1，其餘固定，結果為 0.0006798 1。模型邊界：同一時間窗內獨立失效且切換完美；不含共同原因與切換失敗。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: q1=0.0206 1; q2=0.03 1; calculation: joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000618 1. Sensitivity: q1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.02266 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.0006798 1. Model boundary: Independent failures in one time window with perfect switching; common causes and switch failure are excluded.
units.verify: 畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。 列出兩通道共用的實體與軟體資源，分開注入單路故障及共因故障，核對失效狀態。~Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand. List physical and software resources shared by both channels, inject individual and common-cause faults separately, and verify resulting failure states.
units.failure: 兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。 兩個盒子不等於兩個獨立通道，須核對共用依賴。~Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. Two boxes do not imply two independent channels; inspect their shared dependencies.
units.misconception: 只要設備數量變成兩台失效機率就必定平方降低~Doubling equipment count necessarily squares down the failure probability.
units.practice: 在獨立模型加入一個共同原因機率，對比結果，列出可用物理隔離與不同依賴路徑降低的風險。 再以本單元 q1 的對照值重算 joint_failure，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add one common-cause probability to the independent model, compare the result, and identify risks reduced by physical separation and distinct dependencies. Also recalculate joint_failure for the alternative q1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
